art_instructions: Draw a medium shot from eye level showing the Dinosaur actively searching. He should be depicted with his characteristic friendly, upright posture, round snout, and big expressive eyes scanning the area. His smooth pea-green scales and pale mint belly should be visible, with three stubby fingers clearly shown as he looks around. The Dinosaur's small triangular dorsal nubs should run from the back of his head to mid-tail. His expression should show curiosity and determination as he seeks the lost toy. Position him in the center of the frame, looking side to side with his short tail slightly raised. The background should be a simple indoor setting, suggesting he's searching in the main living area where the family spends time, with soft pastel colors and minimal details to maintain focus on the character.
